name: SFA Semicon Co., Ltd.
summary: SFA Semicon Co., Ltd. is a South Korean enterprise specializing in semiconductor solutions. Their extensive product line features advanced packaging technologies such as fan-out wafer level packages, chip-on-chip and chip-on-wafer assemblies, flip chip products, laminates, and lead frames. They also manufacture memory storage devices like micro SD cards, standard SD cards, and solid-state drives, alongside offering bumping products. The company delivers a wide array of services, including full turn-key processes, comprehensive wafer and final testing. Post-production, they provide integrated back-end solutions encompassing laser marking, visual and mechanical inspection, baking, tape and reel packaging, and dry packing for tested integrated circuits. Additional support includes finished goods storage, drop-shipment services, and expert test engineering. Furthermore, SFA Semicon offers IT services for customized test data management. Established in 1998, the firm was initially known as STS Semiconductor & Telecommunications Co., Ltd. until its name change to SFA Semicon Co., Ltd. in April 2016. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Cheonan, South Korea.
